stories.title: Sign up, log in, and end an authenticated session
stories.outcome: An eligible person can obtain and use an authenticated account under the approved authentication contract.

acceptance_criteria.given: an eligible unauthenticated person provides valid approved sign-up fields
acceptance_criteria.then: an account is created with the approved initial role and credential handling

acceptance_criteria.given: an active account with valid credentials
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved authenticated session is established and protected access succeeds

acceptance_criteria.given: invalid, duplicate, or unauthorized sign-up/login input
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved safe error is returned without exposing credentials or protected data

stories.title: View and maintain an approved user profile
stories.outcome: An authorized user can view and, where approved, update profile data.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated authorized user
acceptance_criteria.then: name, role, department, and start date are returned without credential data

acceptance_criteria.given: a user attempts an approved or prohibited profile change
acceptance_criteria.then: the role and field-specific edit policy is enforced

acceptance_criteria.given: missing, malformed, or boundary profile values
acceptance_criteria.when: the profile is created or updated
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved validation result occurs and invalid data is not stored

stories.title: Enforce recruit, manager, and admin access boundaries
stories.outcome: Every protected operation and record is restricted by the approved role and ownership model.

acceptance_criteria.given: a recruit requests diary data
acceptance_criteria.then: only the approved recruit scope and operations are allowed

acceptance_criteria.given: a manager requests recruit data
acceptance_criteria.then: only approved operations for recruits in the manager's oversight scope are allowed

acceptance_criteria.given: a manager requests a report for a recruit
acceptance_criteria.when: the recruit is assigned or unassigned
acceptance_criteria.then: generation succeeds only for the approved oversight relationship

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthenticated or unauthorized request
acceptance_criteria.then: access is denied using the approved status and error shape without leaking data

stories.title: Administer users and inspect all authorized data
stories.outcome: An admin can perform the approved user-management operations and view all application data.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated admin
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin lists or views users and diary data
acceptance_criteria.then: all data within the approved admin scope is available

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated admin
acceptance_criteria.when: an approved create/update/disable/delete user operation is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: the specifically approved operation and validation rules are enforced

acceptance_criteria.given: a non-admin
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin operation or all-data view is requested
acceptance_criteria.then: access is denied without changing data

stories.title: Maintain and filter task entries
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can create, view, edit, delete, and filter task entries.

acceptance_criteria.given: valid approved task values
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized recruit creates a task
acceptance_criteria.then: the task is stored with date, title, description, category, status, and priority and is returned in the recruit's task log

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing authorized task
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated values are stored and displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing authorized task
acceptance_criteria.then: the task is no longer returned under the approved deletion semantics

acceptance_criteria.given: tasks spanning approved dates, categories, and statuses
acceptance_criteria.when: one or more supported filters are applied
acceptance_criteria.then: only matching authorized tasks are returned with approved boundary behavior

acceptance_criteria.given: invalid values or a task outside the caller's scope
acceptance_criteria.when: create, edit, delete, or view is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is rejected and no unauthorized mutation occurs

stories.title: Log and filter issues or blockers
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can record issues and use the approved lifecycle and filters.

acceptance_criteria.given: valid approved issue values
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized recruit logs an issue
acceptance_criteria.then: date, title, description, severity, status, and resolution notes are stored and displayed as approved

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing issue
acceptance_criteria.when: an approved status/resolution/edit/delete operation is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved lifecycle and role rules are enforced

acceptance_criteria.given: issues with multiple approved statuses and severities
acceptance_criteria.when: status or severity filters are applied
acceptance_criteria.then: only matching authorized issues are returned

acceptance_criteria.given: invalid values or an out-of-scope issue
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved safe rejection occurs without unauthorized mutation

stories.title: Submit onboarding feedback
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can submit feedback classified as Positive, Suggestion, or Concern.

acceptance_criteria.given: valid date, subject, approved type, and details
acceptance_criteria.then: the feedback is stored and displayed within the approved visibility scope

acceptance_criteria.given: a type outside Positive, Suggestion, or Concern or other invalid field values
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved validation error occurs and no record is stored

acceptance_criteria.given: existing feedback
acceptance_criteria.when: view, edit, or delete is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: only the approved role and lifecycle operations are permitted

stories.title: Capture tagged additional notes
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can capture free-form dated notes with titles and tags.

acceptance_criteria.given: valid date, title, content, and tags
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized recruit saves a note
acceptance_criteria.then: the note and approved tag representation are stored and displayed in scope

acceptance_criteria.given: empty, malformed, duplicate, excessive, or boundary tag/content values
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved normalization or validation result occurs

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing note
acceptance_criteria.when: view, edit, or delete is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: only approved role and lifecycle operations are permitted

definition_of_ready: Note lifecycle and tag rules approved

stories.title: View dashboard counts and recent diary entries
stories.outcome: An authorized user sees accurate, scoped counts and recent entries across diary categories.

acceptance_criteria.given: known authorized diary fixtures
acceptance_criteria.then: summary counts match the approved categories and scope

acceptance_criteria.given: entries with known dates and ties
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved number, category mix, and deterministic ordering are returned

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthorized user or an authorized user with no visible entries
acceptance_criteria.then: access is denied or an approved empty state is shown without leaking other users' data

stories.title: View task progress and open issues
stories.outcome: An authorized user sees the approved task-completion calculation and open-issue summary.

acceptance_criteria.given: tasks in each approved status
acceptance_criteria.then: the displayed numerator, denominator, and percentage follow the approved formula

acceptance_criteria.given: issues in each approved status
acceptance_criteria.then: only statuses defined as open and records within scope are included

acceptance_criteria.given: zero tasks or zero open issues
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved zero-state result is displayed without divide-by-zero or stale data

definition_of_ready: Task completion and open-status definitions approved

stories.title: Generate scoped date-range reports
stories.outcome: An authorized user can request task, issue, feedback, or combined data for an approved date range.

acceptance_criteria.given: authorized records inside and outside a requested date range
acceptance_criteria.when: a task, issue, feedback, or combined report is requested
acceptance_criteria.then: the report contains exactly the approved in-range records and fields

acceptance_criteria.given: equal, reversed, missing, or boundary dates
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved inclusivity and validation behavior occurs

acceptance_criteria.given: a manager and an assigned recruit
acceptance_criteria.when: the manager requests the recruit's report
acceptance_criteria.then: generation succeeds within the approved scope

acceptance_criteria.given: a manager and an unassigned recruit or other unauthorized target
acceptance_criteria.then: generation is denied and no report data is returned

stories.title: Download report output as PDF or CSV
stories.outcome: An authorized report request produces a parseable PDF or CSV containing the approved content.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized report result
acceptance_criteria.then: a parseable PDF with the approved title, metadata, rows, ordering, and filename is downloaded

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized report result
acceptance_criteria.then: a parseable CSV with approved encoding, columns, escaping, rows, ordering, and filename is downloaded

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized date range with no matching data
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved empty-report behavior and artifact content occur

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthorized request or generation failure
acceptance_criteria.then: no partial or protected file is exposed and the approved error is shown

definition_of_ready: PDF/CSV schema and failure contract approved

stories.title: Run the application on the mandated simple stack
stories.outcome: The frontend, backend, and database use the mandated technologies with an approved data lifetime.

acceptance_criteria.given: documented local prerequisites
acceptance_criteria.when: the approved startup command is run
acceptance_criteria.then: the React/Vite/Tailwind frontend and Python FastAPI backend start successfully
acceptance_criteria.verification: Dependency inspection and startup smoke test

acceptance_criteria.given: the running application
acceptance_criteria.when: the frontend performs a supported operation
acceptance_criteria.then: it communicates with FastAPI and the operation uses SQLite configured in-memory
acceptance_criteria.verification: End-to-end smoke test and configuration inspection

acceptance_criteria.given: stored application data and an approved reset/restart event
acceptance_criteria.then: data retention or loss exactly matches the approved lifetime contract

stories.title: Use core flows responsively
stories.outcome: Approved core pages remain usable at approved desktop and mobile viewport sizes.

acceptance_criteria.given: each core page at an approved narrow viewport
acceptance_criteria.when: the user views and operates the page
acceptance_criteria.then: content, navigation, forms, tables/lists, and downloads remain usable without unintended clipping

acceptance_criteria.given: each core page at an approved wide viewport
acceptance_criteria.when: the user views and operates the page
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved layout is usable and no required control is hidden

acceptance_criteria.given: approved minimum viewport and representative long content
acceptance_criteria.when: forms, tags, errors, and report controls render
acceptance_criteria.then: all required information and actions remain accessible

stories.title: Handle validation, authorization, and operational failures
stories.outcome: Users receive approved, safe, recoverable behavior when core operations cannot succeed.

acceptance_criteria.given: invalid input in any core form or API
acceptance_criteria.then: approved field/general errors are shown and invalid data is not stored

acceptance_criteria.given: expired, missing, or insufficient authorization
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved reauthentication or denial behavior occurs without data exposure

acceptance_criteria.given: a missing or concurrently changed target
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved not-found/conflict behavior occurs without corrupting data

acceptance_criteria.given: an approved simulated backend or report-generation failure
acceptance_criteria.then: a safe recoverable error is shown, secrets/private data are not logged, and retry behavior matches the approved contract

stories.title: Deliver approved extension feature one
stories.outcome: The first human-selected extension provides one independently testable user outcome.

acceptance_criteria.given: Q-012 has an approved first feature
acceptance_criteria.then: its actors, behavior, validation, authorization, data, and exclusions are explicit

acceptance_criteria.given: the approved feature specification
acceptance_criteria.then: all approved positive, negative, boundary, authorization, and failure criteria pass

definition_of_ready: First extension feature selected and fully specified

stories.title: Deliver approved extension feature two
stories.outcome: The second human-selected extension provides one independently testable user outcome.

acceptance_criteria.given: Q-012 has an approved second feature
acceptance_criteria.then: its actors, behavior, validation, authorization, data, and exclusions are explicit

acceptance_criteria.given: the approved feature specification
acceptance_criteria.then: all approved positive, negative, boundary, authorization, and failure criteria pass

definition_of_ready: Second extension feature selected and fully specified
